title: Maximal-excess biregular Paley Hadamard matrix when (2m+1)^2+2 is a prime power
author: Hirasaka, Mitsugu; Momihara, Koji; Suda, Sho
work: A new approach to the excess problem of Hadamard matrices

contexts.scope: Complete authored mathematicalbody and editabletables; allsupportclaimsuncounted

difficulty_reason: The construction first turns a four-intersection set into explicit diagonal row and column switches of the Paley Hadamard matrix, with exactly the two prescribed row sums. Its nonroutine new core constructs that set over a quadratic finite-field extension and evaluates its four intersection numbers using order-eight Gauss sums, trace constraints and Fourier character expansions. Standard finite-field character orthogonality alone does not supply those exact constructions and evaluations; they are retained in full and exceed ordinary PhD qualification exercises.
